chaos.definition:
n. a state of extreme confusion and disorder
n. the formless and disordered state of matter before the creation of the cosmos
n. (Greek mythology) the most ancient of gods; the personification of the infinity of space preceding creation of the universe
n. (physics) a dynamical system that is extremely sensitive to its initial conditions
chaos.translation:
n. 大混乱, 混沌
[化] 混沌; 浑沌

chaotic.definition:
s. lacking a visible order or organization
s. completely unordered and unpredictable and confusing
a. of or relating to a sensitive dependence on initial conditions
chaotic.translation:
a. 混乱的, 无秩序的
[法] 混乱的, 混沌的

chaotic heart.translation: [医] 乱博心(具有多源性过早收缩的心)

chaotically.definition:
r. in a wild and confused manner
r. in a manner suggestive of chaos
